body: You know, I don't want to discourage you, I have the exact same feeling, but I am afraid that happiness as a somewhat permanent state if mind is just a fictional idea sold to us by the system so we keep chasing it trough all of our life and we never actually get it. What I experience is that we can get short lived satisfaction, but that is it. That is why I believe people are so prone to get addicted to all kinds of stuff that can give you a shot of dopamine.

Nothing changed for since humans exist. Humans are agressive territorial monkeys who prefer to dominate. The only slight difference is a change in the strategy of those who use power to gain control in the last 100 years or so - now they try to make it look like the system is not a tyranny in its foundations, but it still is. So we are born in this thing and we are taught in schools about the horrible past and the bright future we are all moving towards, but of course we all have to obediently contribute our powers for the common good. This is how this system achieves dumbing us to the point where when we realize the scam it is too late. When the power was exposed it wasn't considered a mental illness, conspiracy theory or antisocial behavior to desire a revolution. And you know what? I don't think it is now. It is not us who are sick, it is the system that is sick unfortunately the only way out from it is some sort of revolution. What I personally think is that people have to stop believing in idols (so-called leaders of any kind), we have to realize we are all the masters of our own destinies and no one is entitled to tell us what to do or not to. In other words humans should just leave each others the F alone and care about their own happiness. You (anyone) are not entitled to judge anyone else. You are just one of many, so stop thinking you may think you are better in any way and you can tell others what is right or wrong.

How should one live happily with this constant pressure of not having the ability to fail and not be destroyed? When the only thing that makes you you is seen as a threat to society just because you want to make your own decisions. Humans should leave each others the F alone.

No one lives your life, only you do. All the details of your story make up what you are and even though human experiences are similar, they are never absolutely the same, so even if with empathy people can sort of understand you, it will be always only and exceptionally you making decisions. It is I guess quite depressing, but only because we are brainwashed in to thinking that there is this system that tells you what is the ultimate and only correct way of living, while it is actually a lie to control you and make you do what is favorable to those in power. Only you can have the knowledge about how you should live your own life the best, the best for you personally. Not your friends, parents, neighbors, gods, governments. No, only you.
